meta_data.base_class: Provides insights into top <AI> applications based on recent research findings.- applicable for querying various cutting-edge technology fields that have concrete applications in specific industry areas (e.g., Healthcare, Finance, Transportation, Education).

tool_template.name: <class>ApplicationInsights_getTopApplications
tool_template.description: Provides insights into top <class> applications based on recent research findings.

applicationArea.description: The specific area of <class> applications to focus on. Options include 'Healthcare', 'Finance', 'Transportation', and 'Education'.

detailLevel.description: Level of detail required in the application insights.

timeFrame.description: The time frame to consider for gathering insights on <class> applications, such as 'Last Month', 'Last Quarter', or 'Last Year'.

geographicRegion.description: The geographic region to focus on when providing insights into <class> applications, such as 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia'.

targetAudience.description: The target audience for the insights on <class> applications, such as 'Researchers', 'Business Executives', or 'Policy Makers'.

dataSource.description: The source of data that should be used to gather insights into <class> applications, such as 'Academic Journals', 'Industry Reports', or 'Market Surveys'.

trendAnalysis.description: Whether to include an analysis of trends in <class> applications over time.
